combo.tools: V / T / A / R / O / L

key.delete: Delete objects; in figure editing, hides the element instead — restorable.
key.enter: Edit the selection: text enters editing, editable figures enter figure editing
key.escape: Step out one level: text editing → figure element → figure editing → clear selection
key.newline: Insert a line break; plain ⏎ commits
key.saveNamed: Save now as a named point
key.script: Superscript / subscript (in the properties panel text box)
key.tools: Select / text / arrow / rectangle / ellipse / line
key.zEnds: Bring to front / send to back
key.multiSelect: Add / remove objects or figure elements from the selection
key.quickEdit: Open the quick-edit menu for the object
key.cycleOverlap: Cycle the selection through overlapping figure elements
